title: Driver Earnings Terms, Clause 4: Shares of Rider Fees, Tips and Cleaning Payouts
content:
**4.1** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, fee shares post only to an earnings account that is awaiting payout setup, active or on payout hold.

**4.2** When a rider is charged a cancellation fee, the driver who accepted the trip receives the cancellation fee share of it, and of a no-show fee the no-show fee share; nothing is paid when the fee was waived or when the driver cancelled.

**4.3** A tip is paid at the tip share.

**4.4** When a cleaning or damage fee is charged to a rider, the reporting driver receives the cleaning fee share of a cleaning fee or the damage fee share of a damage fee, on the assessment's own reference.

**4.5** When the rider's fee is later reversed or reduced for a reason that undoes it, the driver's share of the amount returned is taken back as an adjustment debit (a cancellation-fee reversal or a cleaning-fee reversal). A fee returned to the rider as a courtesy, or a cleaning fee reversed as a first-incident courtesy, stays with the driver.

The share percentages are those of the driver pay schedule for rider fees and tips.

## Clause 4.2 and 4.5 as a decision table

| Rider charge and what happened to it | Driver's position |
|---|---|
| Cancellation fee charged, trip accepted by this driver, driver did not cancel | Receives the cancellation fee share |
| No-show fee charged, trip accepted by this driver | Receives the no-show fee share |
| Fee waived | Nothing paid |
| Driver cancelled the trip | Nothing paid |
| Rider's fee later reversed or reduced for a reason that undoes it | Driver's share of the amount returned is taken back as a cancellation-fee reversal or cleaning-fee reversal |
| Fee returned to the rider as a courtesy | Share stays with the driver |
| Cleaning fee reversed as a first-incident courtesy | Share stays with the driver |

## Status of the account and fee shares

| Earnings account status | Fee shares post? |
|---|---|
| Awaiting payout setup, active, or on payout hold | Yes |
| Closed | No |

## Hypothetical illustration

A rider is charged a cancellation fee of 5.00; at an 80% share the accepting driver receives 4.00. If that fee is later reduced by 2.50 for a reason that undoes it, the driver's share of the amount returned, 2.00, is taken back as a cancellation-fee reversal. If instead the 5.00 is returned to the rider as a courtesy, the 4.00 stays with the driver.
